cards.design_implication: If similar sensitivity thresholds are required for the new design, the analysis pipeline should be calibrated to achieve a network SNR of at least 13 and statistical significance exceeding 5σ.
does_not_establish: The specific hardware configuration required to reach these detection metrics.
The causal relationship between specific calibration steps and the observed SNR.
cards.evidence_excerpt: Subsequent off-line analyses recovered GW151226 with a network signal-to-noise ratio of 13 and a significance greater than 5σ.
limitations: The abstract does not specify the exact instrument settings or calibration procedures used to achieve this SNR.
The design of the offline analysis is not detailed.
cards.statement: The observation of GW151226 utilized a network signal-to-noise ratio of 13 and a significance greater than 5σ in offline analyses.
